items.answer: Given by d = √((x₁ − x₂)² + (y₁ − y₂)² + (z₁ − z₂)²)

items.stem: Explain why the 3D distance formula is an extension of Pythagoras' theorem.
items.answer: Apply Pythagoras in the base plane to get √(Δx² + Δy²), then again in the vertical right-angled triangle with the height difference Δz: d² = Δx² + Δy² + Δz².
items.markingKey: Award marks for: Apply Pythagoras in the base plane to get √(Δx² + Δy²), then again in the vertical right-angled triangle with the height difference Δz: d² = Δx² + Δy² + Δz². (2 marks: one for each linked point in the chain of reasoning; no marks for assertion without explanation.)

items.stem: A window is designed as a sector OAB of a circle with centre O, radius 22.2 cm and angle AOB = 52°. (a) Find the arc length AB. (b) Find the length of the chord AB.
